id.description: A unique integer value identifying this dashboard.

widgets.description: Widget tiles to add atomically. Supported widget_type values: activity_events_list, canvas_app, conversations_recent_tickets, error_tracking_list, experiment_results, experiments_list, logs_list, notebook_widget, session_replay_list, survey_results. Use dashboard-widget-catalog-list for per-type config_schema documentation. (1–10 per request).

config.description: Widget configuration as a JSON object. Its keys depend on widget_type: read that type's config_schema from dashboard-widget-catalog-list. The API validates the config and returns a 400 that names each invalid field.

description.description: Optional markdown description shown when show_description is enabled.

layouts.description: Optional react-grid-layout positions keyed by breakpoint (sm, xs).

sm.description: Layout for the standard (desktop) breakpoint. The grid is 12 columns wide.

w.description: Width in grid columns. The desktop grid is 12 columns wide.

x.description: Column position in the dashboard grid (0-indexed).

y.description: Row position in the dashboard grid (0-indexed).

xs.description: Layout for the small (mobile) breakpoint, on a 1-column grid. The dashboard derives this layout from the sm order and heights, so a stored xs box does not change what renders.

w.description: Width in grid columns. The desktop grid is 12 columns wide.

x.description: Column position in the dashboard grid (0-indexed).

y.description: Row position in the dashboard grid (0-indexed).

name.description: Optional custom display name for the widget tile.

show_description.description: Whether to show the description on the dashboard tile.

widget_type.description:
Widget type to add. Use dashboard-widget-catalog-list to pick one.

* `activity_events_list` - activity_events_list
* `canvas_app` - canvas_app
* `conversations_recent_tickets` - conversations_recent_tickets
* `error_tracking_list` - error_tracking_list
* `experiment_results` - experiment_results
* `experiments_list` - experiments_list
* `logs_list` - logs_list
* `notebook_widget` - notebook_widget
* `session_replay_list` - session_replay_list
* `survey_results` - survey_results
